specs.Sensor Type: Heart Rate Sensor, Hrv Sensor, Accelerometer, Gyroscope, Spo2 Sensor, Stress Monitor Sensor, Sleep Tracking Sensor

features: HEART RATE & HRV ANALYSIS: Continuously monitors your heart rate and analyses Heart Rate Variability to give deeper insights into your cardiovascular health.
STRESS & SLEEP TRACKING: Tracks your stress levels throughout the day and monitors sleep stages to help you understand and improve your overall well-being.
25+ DAYS BATTERY LIFE: Long-lasting battery keeps the fitness band running for over 25 days on a single charge, reducing the need for frequent recharging.
30+ SPORTS MODES: Supports more than 30 sports modes to accurately track a wide variety of workouts and physical activities tailored to your fitness goals.
SUBSCRIPTION FREE: Enjoy full access to all features and health data without any recurring subscription fees or hidden charges.

The information and measurements provided by the device are intended for general fitness and wellness purposes only and are not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, prevent, or monitor any medical condition. Do not use the device as a substitute for professional medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment.
description: The FITIX QFit Smart Fitness Band is a feature-packed wearable designed to keep you on top of your health and fitness goals around the clock. Equipped with continuous heart rate monitoring and advanced HRV analysis, it gives you meaningful insights into your cardiovascular health and recovery levels. The built-in stress monitoring feature helps you understand and manage your daily stress patterns, while comprehensive sleep tracking analyses your rest quality so you can wake up feeling your best. With an impressive battery life of 25+ days, you can wear it through your busiest weeks without constantly reaching for the charger. Whether you are a runner, cyclist, swimmer, or yoga enthusiast, the 30+ sports modes ensure your workouts are accurately tracked. Best of all, there are no subscription fees involved, so all features are available to you right out of the box. A reliable companion for anyone serious about their well-being.
